name: JSON Formatter
description: Format, minify, validate and visualize JSON. Handles large files and runs entirely on your machine
help: Input is processed in real time by the local Rust engine; your data never leaves this machine.
Format / Minify / Validate support strict JSON as well as relaxed JSON5 (comments, trailing commas, single quotes).
Errors highlight the offending line; click “Go to error” to jump there.
The tree view loads nodes on demand so large files stay smooth; stats show type counts and nesting depth.
Compare performs a structural diff and lists added, removed and changed paths.
